mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 69 degrees at Fireman Park with clear skies and a first quarter moon overhead, though there are no visible ISS passes to spot tonight.

In city news, the Verona cable channel VHAT is your source for local government meetings, and if you are dealing with yard waste, you can manage it through home composting or by using the free Food Scrap Stop program at Badger Prairie County Park.
We have a busy week ahead with Hop Haus Trivia and Lake Louie trivia this Tuesday, followed by the Downtown Farmer's Market and more trivia at The Bogey Factory on Wednesday.
Looking at the police report from this past week, on July 15, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Prairie Oaks Drive which resulted in an arrest for felony bail jumping.

Today is a great day to enjoy the Chocolate Caramel Twist, but since the restaurant is currently closed, make sure to stop by when they open at 10 AM, and keep an eye out for tomorrow's flavor which will be Mint Explosion.
